vocab.definition: how quickly reactants are used up or products are made.
the minimum energy needed for a successful collision.
speeds up a reaction without being used up.
particles must collide with enough energy to react.

misconceptions.wrong: A catalyst is used up in the reaction.
misconceptions.right: A catalyst is unchanged and can be reused.
Heating gives particles more energy, not more particles.
A catalyst lowers the activation energy.

infoPanels.title: REACTION PROFILE (EXOTHERMIC)
infoPanels.secondaryContent: Products are lower than reactants, so energy is released. A catalyst lowers Eₐ.
